message.content:
This is a mixed fertilizer containing N, P, and K, so it falls in heading 3105. Heading 3105 covers mineral or chemical fertilizers containing two or three of the fertilizing elements nitrogen, phosphorus, and potassium, and it includes packages not exceeding 10 kg.

Subheading 3105.20 covers fertilizers containing all three elements (N, P, K). The product is a liquid, and the 3105.20 subheading has no sub-split by form. The statistical suffix is 3105.20.0000, which is the usual code for NPK fertilizers.

However, the product contains organic components such as amino acids, humic substances, and seaweed extract, so I considered whether it might belong in 3101 (animal or vegetable fertilizers). The description calls it a mineral fertilizer with guaranteed N-P-K, and the organic content is an additive, so 3105.20 is the better fit. Rulings on similar products with NPK plus organics have gone to 3105.20.0000 or, where the product is a mixture, to 3105.90.

Because the guaranteed analysis lists all three elements, I chose 3105.20.0000.

{"hts_code": "3105.20.0000", "reason": "Liquid foliar fertilizer with guaranteed nitrogen, phosphorus and potassium is a mineral/chemical fertilizer containing all three fertilizing elements, classified in HTSUS 3105.20."}
